audit_status.source_base: Greek Ephesians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for mystery of nations as co-heirs, stewardship of grace, manifold wisdom to powers, rooted in love, fullness of Divine.

verses.restored: Because of this I, Paul, the prisoner of Messiah Jesus on behalf of you, the nations—

familiar.text: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

modern.text: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...

original.text: Τούτου χάριν ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν—

verses.restored: if indeed you heard of the stewardship/administration of the grace of the Divine given to me for you,

familiar.text: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:

modern.text: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,

original.text: εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς·

verses.restored: that according to unveiling the mystery was made known to me, just as I wrote before in brief,

familiar.text: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

modern.text: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.

original.text: ⸀κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν ⸀ἐγνωρίσθη μοι τὸ μυστήριον, καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ,

verses.restored: by which, reading, you are able to perceive my insight in the mystery of Messiah,

familiar.text: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

modern.text: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,

original.text: πρὸς ὃ δύνασθε ἀναγινώσκοντες νοῆσαι τὴν σύνεσίν μου ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

verses.restored: which in other generations was not made known to the children of humans as now it has been unveiled to his holy apostles and prophets in Spirit:

familiar.text: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

modern.text: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.

original.text: ὃ ἑτέραις γενεαῖς οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη τοῖς ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ προφήταις ἐν πνεύματι,

verses.restored: that the nations are co-heirs and co-body and co-sharers of the promise in Messiah Jesus through the good news,

familiar.text: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

modern.text: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.

original.text: εἶναι τὰ ἔθνη συγκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ⸂ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ⸃ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

verses.restored: of which I became servant according to the gift of the grace of the Divine given to me according to the working of his power.

familiar.text: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

modern.text: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.

original.text: οὗ ⸀ἐγενήθην διάκονος κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ ⸂τῆς δοθείσης⸃ μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ—

verses.restored: To me, the least of all holy ones, this grace was given: to announce to the nations the unsearchable riches of Messiah,

familiar.text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

modern.text: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

original.text: ἐμοὶ τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις αὕτη— ⸀τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαι ⸂τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος⸃ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

verses.restored: and to illuminate all as to what is the stewardship/administration of the mystery hidden from the ages in the Divine who created all things,

familiar.text: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

modern.text: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.

original.text: καὶ φωτίσαι ⸀πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἐν τῷ θεῷ τῷ τὰ πάντα ⸀κτίσαντι,

verses.restored: so that now, through the assembly, the many-sided wisdom of the Divine might be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenlies,

familiar.text: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

modern.text: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,

original.text: ἵνα γνωρισθῇ νῦν ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ,

verses.restored: according to the purpose of the ages which he made in Messiah Jesus our Lord,

familiar.text: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

modern.text: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

original.text: κατὰ πρόθεσιν τῶν αἰώνων ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν ⸀τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν,

verses.restored: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through his trust/faithfulness.

familiar.text: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

modern.text: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.

original.text: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν ⸀καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν πεποιθήσει διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: Therefore I ask you not to lose heart in my pressures on behalf of you, which is your glory.

familiar.text: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

modern.text: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory. Paul’s Prayer for the Ephesians

original.text: διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ⸀ἐγκακεῖν ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσίν μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἐστὶν δόξα ὑμῶν.

verses.restored: Because of this I bend my knees toward the Father,

familiar.text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

modern.text: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,

original.text: Τούτου χάριν κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν ⸀πατέρα,

verses.restored: from whom every family/fatherhood in heavens and upon earth is named,

familiar.text: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

modern.text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.

original.text: ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται,

verses.restored: so that he may give you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner human,

familiar.text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

modern.text: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,

original.text: ἵνα ⸀δῷ ὑμῖν κατὰ ⸂τὸ πλοῦτος⸃ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ δυνάμει κραταιωθῆναι διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον,

verses.restored: for Messiah to dwell through trust in your hearts, having been rooted and founded in love,

familiar.text: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

modern.text: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,

original.text: κατοικῆσαι τὸν Χριστὸν διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ· ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι,

verses.restored: so that you may be fully strong to comprehend with all the holy ones what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

familiar.text: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

modern.text: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth

original.text: ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ⸂ὕψος καὶ βάθος⸃,

verses.restored: and to know the love of Messiah surpassing knowledge, so that you may be filled into all the fullness of the Divine.

familiar.text: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

modern.text: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

original.text: γνῶναί τε τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ θεοῦ.

verses.restored: Now to the One able to do beyond all things, beyond measure of what we ask or perceive, according to the power working in us,

familiar.text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

modern.text: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,

original.text: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν,

verses.restored: to him be glory in the assembly and in Messiah Jesus into all generations of the age of the ages. Amen.

familiar.text: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

modern.text: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

original.text: αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ⸀καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

translation_notes: Syn- compounds in 3:6 are preserved as co-heirs, co-body, co-sharers to highlight radical shared belonging of nations in Messiah.
Many-sided wisdom in 3:10 preserves polypoikilos, the manifold/multicolored wisdom of the Divine made known through the assembly.
Fullness of Divine in 3:19 is the mystical high point of the prayer.
